name: Samoa

flag.description: A red field with a blue rectangle in the upper hoist containing the Southern Cross as five white five-pointed stars, one of them smaller.
flag.symbolism: The Southern Cross marks Samoa's place in the southern sky; red is said to stand for courage, blue for freedom and white for purity.

hook: Samoa: a red flag with a blue corner holding the five white stars of the Southern Cross; Taiwan's blue corner holds a white sun instead.
trivia: Samoa skipped 30 December 2011 entirely when it moved to the west side of the International Date Line.
In 2009 Samoa switched from driving on the right to driving on the left.
The country was called Western Samoa until 1997.
